description: deviation.rs:1047 and deviation.rs:1141 — both test functions contain 'use der::Decode as _;' after let-statements. clippy::items_after_statements fires. Fix: move the use-import to the top of the test module (in the tests mod block), before any test fn bodies. Consistent with how lib.rs tests use 'use der::Decode as _' already at module scope.
title: [rusty/pkix-lint] items_after_statements: use-import inside test bodies
